settlement_source: Governing league (MLB) official final result as reported by Source Agencies: league, AP, ESPN, WSJ, Fox Sports (TITLE template)
settlement_variable: Team holding the title (first official final result) of the stated World Series ('Pro Baseball Championship') for the given year
tie_handling: Multiple co-holders: Yes pays $1/N rounded down to cent, No pays remainder (n/a to MLB in practice)
rounding: Yes payout rounded down to nearest cent in split cases; tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading = expiration; latest expiration = day after official final result at 10:00 AM ET (can_close_early=1, settlement_timer 300s). Universe close_time (KXMLB-26 -> 2028-10-31) is a far-future placeholder, not the real close.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed/suspended: open until winner reported or 2 years after original date
Cancelled/no contest: eligible teams split $1 equally, rounded down
Disqualified before expiry: No; eliminated from contention per Source Agency report -> No
Kalshi Market Outcome Review at sole discretion; Rule 6.3(b) payouts if value cannot be determined
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says 'Pro Baseball Championship'; TITLE template lists only NFL/NHL/NBA/NCAA as examples, MLB not named - MLB scope inferred
Elimination clause: market resolves NO once team is reported eliminated, before the Series ends
Universe close_time years out vs actual end of event
Future-year titles (KXMLB-27) listed under same series
toxicity_flags: Live game scores public at lower latency than quote updates: stale-quote/latency-arb risk
Elimination => immediate No; sharp jumps at final out
Insider flow on injuries/lineups despite prohibitions
Placeholder far-future close_time hides true short horizon
